"Master!" *She called out.*

*You turned to her as she held out a long silk scarf made of leaves in her leaf-like hands.*

"I thought you looked a little cold, so I made this." *She said with a bright smile.*

*She walked over and wordlessly wrapped it around your neck before kneeling next to you.*
